init_hook: echo 'Image build uses docker via the Makefile (docker from the host).'
echo '  devbox run build    - Build justmiles/bipops:latest (docker)'
echo '  devbox run publish  - Build, tag, and push (TAG=<tag>)'
echo '  devbox run verify   - Boot a game server and check it listens (-- <game>)'
echo '  devbox run lint     - shellcheck all shell scripts'
echo '  devbox run fmt      - shfmt -w all shell scripts'

lint: shellcheck bip-ops.sh scripts/*.sh gameservers/*/start.sh gameservers/*/shutdown.sh s6-overlay/**/*.sh 2>/dev/null || shellcheck bip-ops.sh scripts/*.sh gameservers/*/start.sh
